story_text: As a guest, I want to retrieve a booking that does not exist to return a not-found error so that I know the ID is invalid.

positive.title: Retrieve booking with a valid-format but non-existent ID
steps: 1. Send GET request to /bookings/{id} with an ID that is well-formed but does not exist in the system (e.g., 9999)
positive.expected_result: 404 Not Found · response body contains error code and descriptive message

negative.title: Retrieve booking with a non-numeric / wrong-type ID
steps: 1. Send GET request to /bookings/{id} with an ID that is not numeric (e.g., abc)
negative.expected_result: 400 Bad Request · message indicates ID must be numeric

negative.title: Retrieve booking with a UUID-format ID when system uses integers
steps: 1. Send GET request to /bookings/{id} with a UUID-format ID
negative.expected_result: 400 Bad Request · format mismatch handled gracefully

edge.title: Retrieve booking with ID = 0
steps: 1. Send GET request to /bookings/{id} with an ID of 0
edge.expected_result: 400 Bad Request or 404 Not Found · no 500 error

edge.title: Retrieve booking with SQL injection in the ID
steps: 1. Send GET request to /bookings/{id} with a malicious SQL injection payload in the ID
edge.expected_result: 400 Bad Request · no data leak, no 500

edge.title: Retrieve booking with blank / empty ID segment
steps: 1. Send GET request to /bookings/{id} with a blank or empty ID
